summary: Tested Growth Curve (riwayat CRUD), Balita update/delete, Statistik Kelurahan endpoints and full UI flow across Pasien/Admin/Dokter dashboards. 19/19 backend pytest cases passed and all critical frontend flows verified (public /statistik, Kurva modal with BB/TB/Riwayat tabs, add pengukuran, admin statistik tab, dokter compact statistik).

issues: TB status badge shows 'Pendek' for TB 88 cm @ 35 months which is actually stunted - this label is correct but worth re-checking WHO TB/U thresholds in frontend logic to avoid mis-labelling normal cases. Non-blocking.
PieChart legend overlaps slice labels when there are only 2 slices; consider moving legend below or constraining label position. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _calc_status_kms uses simple linear (7.3 + usia*0.16) approximation instead of real WHO BB/U LMS data. Backend status_kms therefore differs from the WHO-line based UI - acceptable for MVP but should be aligned (use whoStandards.js LMS on backend as well) so 'Gizi Baik/Kurang/BGM' classification is consistent across DB and chart.
server.py is now 653 lines - approaching 700-line threshold; recommend splitting routers into separate modules (auth.py, admin.py, pasien.py, dokter.py, public.py) before adding more features.

add_pengukuran sets balita's current berat_badan/tinggi_badan/usia from the latest entry by date - but if user adds an OLDER measurement and that becomes 'latest' alphabetically, current fields still update correctly because of sort by tanggal. Verified.
WebSocket auth: token is validated but no role/ownership check (any valid token can subscribe to any konsultasi_id). Pre-existing issue, not introduced by this iteration.

delete_pengukuran does not recompute current berat_badan/tinggi_badan/usia/status_kms after deletion - if the deleted entry was the latest, card will keep stale values until next add. Suggest re-deriving 'current' fields from remaining riwayat after delete.
Frontend has no loading-state guard around add-pengukuran Simpan button - user can double click and create duplicate entries. Add disabled state during request.
